## 
        Ouster Announces Upcoming Investor Events

[ Ouster, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fouster.com%2F&esheet=54438927&newsitemid=20260304709100&lan=en-US&anchor=Ouster%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=bb166ac2f2e47219cf869dba65bc30fa) (Nasdaq: OUST) (“Ouster” or the “Company”), a leader in sensing and perception for Physical AI, today announced that Ouster management will participate in the following investor events:

|

38th Annual  | |

|

Institutional investors interested in a meeting should contact their representative at either firm or email Ouster investor relations at [investors@ouster.io](mailto:investors@ouster.io).

**About Ouster**

Ouster (Nasdaq: OUST) is a leader in sensing and perception for Physical AI across industrial, robotics, automotive, and smart infrastructure. With a unified platform of high-performance digital lidar, cameras, AI compute, sensor fusion and perception software, and AI models, Ouster delivers solutions that improve quality of life in the physical world. Headquartered in [www.ouster.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ouster.com&esheet=54438927&newsitemid=20260304709100&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ouster.com&index=2&md5=53a5f5864ded7fec117d060c195465ec), contact our [sales team](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fouster.com%2Ftalk-to-sales&esheet=54438927&newsitemid=20260304709100&lan=en-US&anchor=sales+team&index=3&md5=d19a1e28ebde63d5b33f1f6e72651f17), or connect with us on [X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fousterlidar&esheet=54438927&newsitemid=20260304709100&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=4&md5=1b5e4b60b0aed627dcc4211a5df73bc2) or [LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fouster%2F&esheet=54438927&newsitemid=20260304709100&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=0ff565ae5565645c6c6210653ccc5faa).
